title: ArcCivs 0.1.127: bounded access to an accepted forestry crown
assumptions: The accepted saved forestry job, its cell cursor and harvested item receipts remain unchanged. No item or block is granted to recover a closed approach.

Ordinary access retains the existing three-block reach, supported and body-clear stance, chunk, world authority and exact captured native batch checks. Only nonpersistent, nonwaterlogged natural leaves may obscure its forestry ray, using the existing captured-forestry trace policy.
Stone, glass, water and persistent foliage still obstruct work. Ignoring natural foliage for this bounded ray does not authorize changing an uncaptured leaf or any extra block.
A completed approach sweep with zero admitted stances uses the existing bounded retry interval. A service-budget yield is not exhaustion; saved progress is not discarded.
Per-operation output quantities, native source-to-bag-to-container receipts, tools, recipes, work timers, storage headroom, prices and player rewards remain unchanged.
Realized forestry throughput may recover from a stalled baseline and is not measured or valued as a guaranteed income increase. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL and separate contracts remain unchanged.
conclusion: No direct currency, item grant or per-operation quantity change. Recovery must be verified through the existing exact forestry and cargo receipts after activation.
